title: The Broken Cup
logline: Maya breaks Gramps Lou's favorite cup and says she doesn't know what happened.
conflict: The cup is broken on the floor and Maya is the only one who was in the room.
wrong_solution: Maya says the cup 'just fell' on its own.
right_solution: Maya tells Gramps Lou the truth and helps look for a way to fix it.
practice_for_viewer: Pick one small true thing to say out loud today, even if it's a little embarrassing.
shorts_hook: The moment right before Maya decides what to say.

title: The Unfinished Tower
logline: Maya and Theo's block tower keeps falling and Maya wants to quit.
conflict: The tower falls twice and building it is boring now.
wrong_solution: Maya walks away and starts something else.
right_solution: Maya and Theo figure out what keeps making it fall and try once more.
practice_for_viewer: Pick one thing you stopped this week and try it one more time.
shorts_hook: The tower falling for the second time.

title: The Candy on the Counter
logline: Maya is told she can have candy after dinner, and dinner is very far away.
conflict: The candy is sitting right there, in reach, before dinner.
wrong_solution: Maya sneaks a piece early.
right_solution: Maya finds something else to do while she waits.
practice_for_viewer: Pick one small wait today and notice how it feels before and after.
shorts_hook: Maya's hand reaching, then stopping.

title: Too Heavy to Carry
logline: Maya tries to move a crate by herself at the fix-it stand instead of asking Gramps Lou.
conflict: The crate is too heavy and Maya keeps trying alone.
wrong_solution: Maya strains and nearly hurts herself rather than ask.
right_solution: Maya asks Gramps Lou for help and they move it together.
practice_for_viewer: Think of one thing that's too big to do alone, and say so out loud.
shorts_hook: Maya struggling alone before she asks.

title: Sam's Crayon
logline: Maya has the only red crayon in class and Sam wants a turn.
conflict: Sam asks for the red crayon and Maya doesn't want to give it up.
wrong_solution: Maya hides the crayon and pretends she doesn't have it.
right_solution: Maya shares the crayon for a few minutes, on her own terms.
practice_for_viewer: Pick one thing you can share today, and one thing it's still OK to keep.
shorts_hook: Maya's hand closing around the crayon.

title: Two Dollars
logline: Maya earns two dollars and has to decide whether to spend it now or save it.
conflict: A toy at the store costs exactly two dollars.
wrong_solution: Maya spends both dollars right away.
right_solution: Maya saves one dollar toward something bigger, with Gramps Lou's help doing the math.
practice_for_viewer: If you have any money saved, count it and say what it's for.
shorts_hook: The toy in the store window.

title: The Storm in My Chest
logline: Maya can't tell if she's mad or scared after a scary moment on the swings.
conflict: Something startles Maya and the feeling is big and confusing.
wrong_solution: Maya yells at Theo, who didn't do anything.
right_solution: Nell helps Maya find the right word for what she's feeling.
practice_for_viewer: Next time you feel big, try naming it out loud: mad, sad, or scared.
shorts_hook: Maya's chest-storm moment, before the word.

title: I Messed Up the Drawing
logline: Maya ruins Theo's poster by accident and wants to hide it.
conflict: A smear of marker ruins hours of Theo's work.
wrong_solution: Maya covers the poster with a book and says nothing.
right_solution: Maya tells Theo and helps redo the part she ruined.
practice_for_viewer: If you made a mistake this week, do one thing today to help fix it.
shorts_hook: The book coming off the ruined poster.

title: The Missing Cookie
logline: A cookie disappears before dinner and Maya has crumbs on her shirt.
conflict: Mom asks who took the cookie and Maya has the evidence on her.
wrong_solution: Maya says she 'doesn't know,' crumbs and all.
right_solution: Maya admits it and offers to skip dessert to make it fair.
practice_for_viewer: Notice one moment today where the truth feels harder than the easy answer.
shorts_hook: The crumbs Maya forgot about.

title: Not My Drawing
logline: Maya scribbles on Theo's poster by accident and blames the dog.
conflict: The dog gets blamed for something Maya did.
wrong_solution: Maya lets the dog take the blame.
right_solution: Maya corrects the story once she sees Theo is genuinely sad.
practice_for_viewer: If someone else got blamed for something today, say so.
shorts_hook: Theo's face when he hears it was the dog, then the correction.

title: The Late Homework
logline: Maya tells Ms. Rivera her homework is 'at home' when it isn't done at all.
conflict: Homework is due and Maya didn't do it.
wrong_solution: Maya claims it's finished, just forgotten.
right_solution: Maya admits it's not done and asks for one more night.
practice_for_viewer: If something isn't finished, practice saying so plainly.
shorts_hook: Maya searching her empty backpack.

title: The Bike With Training Wheels Off
logline: Maya's training wheels come off and she gives up after two falls.
conflict: The bike keeps tipping over on the first two tries.
wrong_solution: Maya declares she'll never ride it and rolls it into the garage.
right_solution: Maya tries a third time with Gramps Lou steadying the seat.
practice_for_viewer: Pick one wobble-and-fall thing and try it once more today.
shorts_hook: The second fall, and the long pause after.

title: The Puzzle With 100 Pieces
logline: A new puzzle looks impossible once it's only half sorted.
conflict: The pieces are all mixed up and the picture looks nowhere close.
wrong_solution: Maya sweeps the pieces back into the box.
right_solution: Maya sorts by edge pieces first and finds the corners.
practice_for_viewer: Break one big thing into a smaller first step today.
shorts_hook: The box getting swept shut, then reopened.

title: Reading the Chapter Book
logline: Maya switches back to picture books when the words in her new book get hard.
conflict: A word Maya doesn't know stops her mid-page.
wrong_solution: Maya quietly swaps the book for an easier one.
right_solution: Maya sounds out the hard word and keeps going.
practice_for_viewer: Don't skip the hard part today, slow down on it instead.
shorts_hook: The stuck word on the page.

title: The Swing Line
logline: Maya cuts the swing line at the park because waiting is taking forever.
conflict: The line for the one good swing is long.
wrong_solution: Maya cuts to the front.
right_solution: Maya finds something else to do until her turn comes around.
practice_for_viewer: Next time there's a line, notice what you do while you wait.
shorts_hook: Maya stepping toward the front of the line.

title: The Present Under the Tree
logline: A wrapped present under the tree is too tempting not to peek at.
conflict: The present has Maya's name on it, days before it's time.
wrong_solution: Maya sneaks a corner open to peek.
right_solution: Maya finds a way to make the waiting itself a little fun.
practice_for_viewer: Think of one thing you're waiting for, and one way to make the wait better.
shorts_hook: The corner of wrapping paper, pulled back.

title: Stuck on the Fence
logline: Maya climbs too high on the fence and won't call for help.
conflict: Maya is stuck higher than she meant to go.
wrong_solution: Maya tries to jump down instead of calling out.
right_solution: Maya calls for Gramps Lou instead of jumping.
practice_for_viewer: If you're stuck on something today, say the word 'help' out loud.
shorts_hook: Maya's hand gripping the fence, deciding.

title: The Homework I Don't Get
logline: Maya pretends to understand a math worksheet instead of asking Ms. Rivera.
conflict: The numbers on the page don't make sense to Maya.
wrong_solution: Maya guesses and turns it in without asking.
right_solution: Maya raises her hand and admits she's confused.
practice_for_viewer: Next time something's confusing, ask one question about it out loud.
shorts_hook: Maya staring at the worksheet, pencil frozen.
flag: Keep the confusion ordinary, no hint of shame about not understanding.

title: The Blanket Fort Rule
logline: Nell wants into the fort Maya just finished building alone.
conflict: Nell wants in on something Maya built by herself.
wrong_solution: Maya says nobody's allowed in, ever.
right_solution: Maya sets one simple rule and lets Nell in on it.
practice_for_viewer: Pick one thing that's yours, and one small way to include someone in it anyway.
shorts_hook: Nell's face at the fort entrance.

title: My Diary, Not Yours
logline: Theo wants to read Maya's notebook and Maya has to say no.
conflict: Theo reaches for Maya's notebook without asking.
wrong_solution: Maya grabs it back without a word and stays upset all day.
right_solution: Maya says out loud that the notebook is private, and why that's OK.
practice_for_viewer: Practice saying 'that's private' about one thing today.
shorts_hook: Theo's hand on the notebook.

title: Gramps Lou's Job
logline: Maya earns her first dollar sweeping the fix-it stand and wants to spend it all on candy immediately.
conflict: A dollar earned feels like it's already spent.
wrong_solution: Maya runs straight to buy candy with all of it.
right_solution: Maya splits it: some now, some saved, with Gramps Lou's help.
practice_for_viewer: If you earn or receive any money this week, decide on it before you spend it.
shorts_hook: The dollar in Maya's hand, on the way to the candy shelf.

title: The Yard Sale
logline: Maya prices her old toys for a yard sale and learns worth isn't just how much she wants them.
conflict: Maya prices everything sky-high because she loves it all.
wrong_solution: Nobody buys anything all morning.
right_solution: Gramps Lou helps her reprice based on what things are actually worth to others.
practice_for_viewer: Pick one old toy and think about what it's really worth to someone else.
shorts_hook: The empty yard sale table at noon.
flag: Pricing/value is abstract for 5-7. Keep numbers tiny and concrete.

title: Give Some Away
logline: Maya decides whether to give part of her saved money to something else.
conflict: Maya has saved money and hears about something it could help.
wrong_solution: Maya keeps all of it, uneasy about the choice.
right_solution: Maya gives a small part of it away, on her own terms.
practice_for_viewer: Talk about one thing your family gives to, and why.
shorts_hook: Maya's coin jar, half-open.
flag: Giving/altruism is abstract for 5-7. Anchor it to one concrete, visible recipient.

title: Butterflies or Bees?
logline: Maya feels excited and nervous at once on the first day back at school.
conflict: Maya's stomach feels weird and she can't tell if it's good or bad.
wrong_solution: Maya says she feels sick and almost stays home.
right_solution: Maya learns a feeling can be two things at once, and that's normal.
practice_for_viewer: Name one time you felt two feelings at once today.
shorts_hook: Maya's hand on her stomach, unsure.
flag: Mixed emotions are a harder concept at 5-7. Keep it to exactly two named feelings.

title: Nell's Big Cry
logline: Nell melts down and can't explain why, so Maya helps her find the word.
conflict: Nell is crying hard with no clear reason on the surface.
wrong_solution: Maya tells Nell to stop crying and calm down.
right_solution: Maya asks simple questions until Nell finds the actual feeling underneath.
practice_for_viewer: Next time someone's upset, ask what they're feeling instead of telling them to stop.
shorts_hook: Nell's cry, then the quiet after she finds the word.

title: The Knocked-Over Blocks
logline: Theo knocks over Maya's tower by accident and Maya wants to yell or hit something.
conflict: Hours of building gone in one bump.
wrong_solution: Maya shoves Theo without thinking.
right_solution: Maya takes a breath, says she's mad, and rebuilds instead.
practice_for_viewer: Next time you're mad, try one breath before you do anything else.
shorts_hook: The tower falling, then Maya's fist clenching.

title: Not Fair, Not My Turn
logline: Maya is furious about turn order at the fix-it stand game.
conflict: Maya thinks she waited longer than everyone else.
wrong_solution: Maya knocks the game pieces over.
right_solution: Maya says 'this isn't fair' out loud instead of wrecking the game.
practice_for_viewer: Next time something feels unfair, say so with words instead of actions.
shorts_hook: The game pieces, mid-scatter.

title: The Slammed Door
logline: Maya slams her door mid-argument with Nell.
conflict: An argument with Nell gets loud fast.
wrong_solution: Maya slams the door and stays angry alone.
right_solution: Maya comes back out once she's calmer and finishes the conversation.
practice_for_viewer: If you need a minute when you're mad, take it, then come back.
shorts_hook: The door, right after it slams.

title: The Kid Nobody Picked
logline: A new kid stands alone at recess and Maya almost doesn't notice.
conflict: A new kid is left out of every game at recess.
wrong_solution: Maya almost walks past without saying anything.
right_solution: Maya invites the new kid into her game.
practice_for_viewer: Notice one person who's alone today, and say hello.
shorts_hook: The new kid, standing alone at the edge of the playground.

title: Theo's Bad Day
logline: Theo is grumpy and short with everyone, and Maya has to decide whether to walk away or stay.
conflict: Theo snaps at Maya for no clear reason.
wrong_solution: Maya snaps back and leaves.
right_solution: Maya stays, asks what's wrong, and finds out Theo had a rough morning.
practice_for_viewer: Next time a friend is snippy, ask what's going on before reacting.
shorts_hook: Theo's snap, then Maya's pause.

title: Standing Up for Nell
logline: An older kid teases Nell, and Maya has to decide whether speaking up is worth it.
conflict: A bigger kid says something unkind to Nell at the park.
wrong_solution: Maya says nothing and pulls Nell away quietly.
right_solution: Maya speaks up calmly and gets an adult if it continues.
practice_for_viewer: Think of one calm thing you could say if you saw this happen.
shorts_hook: The tease, and the beat before Maya decides.
flag: Peer conflict with a bigger kid needs careful, non-scary handling and a clear get-an-adult resolution.

title: The Broken Fence Board
logline: Maya breaks a board at the fix-it stand while playing somewhere she shouldn't.
conflict: Maya was climbing where Gramps Lou asked her not to.
wrong_solution: Maya hides the broken board behind the stand.
right_solution: Maya tells Gramps Lou and helps him fix it.
practice_for_viewer: If you broke a rule this week, tell someone before they find out.
shorts_hook: The board, hidden behind a crate.

title: Forgot Nell at the Park
logline: Distracted, Maya walks off without Nell for a scary few seconds.
conflict: Maya gets absorbed in a game and loses track of Nell.
wrong_solution: Maya keeps playing a beat too long before noticing.
right_solution: Maya finds Nell, apologizes, and they agree on a buddy rule.
practice_for_viewer: Pick one buddy system for the next time you're out with someone younger.
shorts_hook: The empty spot where Nell was standing.

title: Said Something Mean
logline: Maya says something unkind to Theo out of frustration.
conflict: Maya is frustrated and the words come out sharp.
wrong_solution: Maya pretends she didn't mean it and moves on.
right_solution: Maya apologizes specifically, naming what she said and why it was unkind.
practice_for_viewer: If you said something sharp this week, go back and name exactly what you'd change.
shorts_hook: The words landing on Theo's face.

title: The Person at the Door
logline: Someone Maya doesn't know knocks while she's home with Gramps Lou.
conflict: A stranger is at the door and Maya's the closest to it.
wrong_solution: Maya opens the door on her own.
right_solution: Maya gets Gramps Lou before answering, calmly, no scare.
practice_for_viewer: Agree on your own family's door rule and say it out loud.
shorts_hook: The knock, and Maya's hand near the doorknob.

title: Lost at the Park
logline: Maya gets briefly separated from Gramps Lou at a crowded park.
conflict: Maya turns around and Gramps Lou isn't where he was.
wrong_solution: Maya starts wandering to look for him.
right_solution: Maya stays put and finds a helper, like they'd planned.
practice_for_viewer: Pick a stay-put plan with your grown-up for the next crowded place you go.
shorts_hook: The moment Maya realizes she's alone in the crowd.
flag: Keep this calm and procedural, not frightening. The resolution should feel fast and safe.

title: The Tablet Game
logline: A game Maya's playing pops up asking for personal information.
conflict: A pop-up asks Maya to type in her name and address to 'win.'
wrong_solution: Maya starts typing before thinking about it.
right_solution: Maya stops and gets Gramps Lou before typing anything.
practice_for_viewer: Agree on one stop-and-ask-a-grown-up rule for any screen you use.
shorts_hook: The pop-up on screen, and Maya's finger hovering.
flag: Keep this about the simple stop-and-ask rule, not a detailed explanation of online risk.

title: The Bike Left in the Rain
logline: Maya's bike rusts a little because she left it out overnight.
conflict: Rain caught the bike Maya forgot outside.
wrong_solution: Maya is surprised and upset the bike doesn't work as well.
right_solution: Maya cleans it up and starts a habit of putting it away.
practice_for_viewer: Put one thing away today that's usually left out.
shorts_hook: The rusted chain, close up.

title: Borrowed and Broken
logline: Maya borrows Theo's toy and it breaks while she has it.
conflict: The toy breaks on Maya's watch, not Theo's.
wrong_solution: Maya quietly gives it back broken, saying nothing.
right_solution: Maya tells Theo right away and offers to help fix or replace it.
practice_for_viewer: If you're borrowing something this week, treat it like it's extra-precious.
shorts_hook: The toy breaking in Maya's hands.
flag: Keep the emphasis on honesty and repair, not guilt, about someone else's belongings.

title: The Missing Shoe
logline: Maya can't find her shoe every single morning.
conflict: The same shoe goes missing on a school morning, again.
wrong_solution: Maya blames everyone else for moving it.
right_solution: Maya and Gramps Lou set up one spot the shoes always go.
practice_for_viewer: Pick one always-goes-here spot for the thing you lose most.
shorts_hook: The frantic search, then the new shoe spot.
